answer: Admission to the public atlas of voting seats costs a 200 POA lock for 18 epochs and one crystal receipt: SHA-256(address || epoch || 32-byte nonce) plus a job output peers recompute from that nonce. If the nonce already appears on-chain, every colliding bond is slashed 100% and those seats freeze until the next checkpoint. A farm that wants k aliases must find k unused nonces and tie up 200k POA for the full 18 epochs — a nectar too bitter to mint cheap identities.
